newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coop coffee stocks rise to 1.08 mln bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coop coffee stocks rise to 1.08 mln bags.

text.p: Coffee stocks held by Brazilian cooperatives totaled 1.08 60.5-kg bags on June 30, National Coffee Council (CNC) said in a statement.
This is up from 850,395 bags held by cooperatives as of May 31 but below the 1.57 million bags held at the end of June 1996.
Sales by cooperatives reached 298,835 bags in June versus 399,065 bags during May and 432,574 bags in June last year.
Cooperatives received 532,574 bags of coffee during the month of June against 267,985 bags delivered the previous month and 792,150 bags received in June 1996, the CNC said.
This brings the May/June total to 800,559 bags against 1.02 million bags in the same period in 1996.

"While it is early to make more fundamental comparisons between this crop and the previous one, principally because of the rains which have hit the start of the harvest, information supplied by members shows the harvest is consideraly delayed and the volume collected is considerably less than the most pessimistic forecasts," the CNC said.
